香港：人類開採過的黃金，將近一半是金飾，約 99,700 噸；而全球新買的金飾，約一半由兩個國家買走：印度和中國。去年金價不斷破頂，全球買的金飾按重量計反而減少到約 1,500 噸，是 5 年來最低，但花的錢卻創下紀錄：1,720 億美元。影片：Carat Capital 動畫《All the Gold Ever Mined》，旁白為合成聲音。

Hong Kong: nearly half of all the gold ever mined is jewellery, about 99,700 tonnes, and two countries buy about half of the world's new gold jewellery: India and China. Last year, as prices kept breaking records, the world bought less jewellery by weight, about 1,500 tonnes, a five-year low, but spent a record 172 billion dollars on it. Video: Carat Capital's animated film All the Gold Ever Mined, with synthetic narration.

影片來源：Carat Capital, YouTube, 2026年11月5日. 資料：World Gold Council, Gold Demand Trends FY2025 (29 Jan 2026); WGC above-ground stocks, end-Q2 2026.
